title: Annual Budget Allocation for the Ministry of Health
description: Annual federal budget allocated to the Ministry of Health (B/P.42) with a breakdown by expenditure categories, including development expenditure (DE) and operating expenditure (OE).

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 since the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: category
fields.title: Expenditure Category
fields.description: [Categorical] The category of expenditure; either development expenditure (DE), operating expenditure (OE), or a more detailed OE breakdown covering Emoluments (oe_10000), Services and Supplies (oe_20000), Assets (oe_30000), Fixed Payments (oe_40000), and Other Expenditures (oe_50000).

fields.name: allocation
fields.title: Allocation
fields.description: [Integer] Budgeted expenditure for the given category

methodology: This dataset is produced from the [Budget Book tabled in Parliament](https://belanjawan.mof.gov.my/pdf/belanjawan2024/perbelanjaan/BP.42.pdf) and subsequently published by the Ministry of Finance. Categorisation of expenditure is based on the [Classification Codes for Revenue and Expenditure](https://storage.data.gov.my/publicadmin/penjenisan_kod.pdf) published by the Federal Treasury.
caveat: This data reflects budgeted rather than actual expenditures.
